items.title: Tariffs are back as Anthropic sinks further below its IPO price
items.summary: The 8:30 hosts Julie Hyman and Jake Conley, joined on the couch by BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran, tackle the top stories of the day. Including the Trump administration's sweeping new Section 301 tariffs of 20% on China and dozens of other economies, in-line PCE inflation and a third-quarter GDP revision up to 4.3% that keep a December Fed hike in play, Anthropic sliding toward $78 and well below its $83 IPO price, and whether Jensen Huang is the right leader for Nvidia in a new regulatory era.

items.title: Washington Calls It a Goldilocks Economy. On a $2,071 Social Security Check, She Calls It the Annoyance Economy: Prices Up 3.7%, and Her Real Raise Is Just 3.3%
items.summary: Officials say the economy is just right, but a retiree on an average Social Security check sees a January raise shrink before it even arrives. One Medicare line item and one overlooked price index explain why she starts 2027 behind.

items.title: JPMorgan sees $450B in AI bond issuance in 2027
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan Chase & Co. expects companies to raise $450 billion through investment-grade bond markets in 2027 to fund artificial intelligence capital expenditures, up from $368 billion in global investment-grade bond issuance for AI-focused companies this year.

items.title: JPMorgan Sees $450 Billion AI Debt Blitz in 2027 Before Plateau
items.summary: Companies will tap public high-grade debt markets for $450 billion next year to finance their artificial intelligence-related capital expenditures, even as a growth plateau looms for the burgeoning industry further down the road, according to analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co.

items.title: 12 Big Funds Bought JPMorgan Chase Last Quarter, While 12 Sold. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 12 bought JPMorgan Chase and 12 sold. Axiom Investors added about $489 million of the stock, while MKP Capital sold a stake worth about $466 million.
